text: A photograph has more than a scene. It has a material life: paper, glass, labels, drawers and careful handling.  Josh’s supplied photographs show that work of preservation today. Locations and names need evidence. The contemporary archive photos help explain how the collection survives. Uncaptioned negatives stay unassigned; appearance alone does not establish a person’s identity or a Swiss location.
